# GitHub Copilot Repository Instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` and `.ai/conventions.md` for requests that may change software code, behavior, tests, technical configuration, schemas, dependencies, build or deployment configuration, or CC Flow itself. Read the project, profile, architecture, business, and progress files under `.ai/` before proposing non-trivial changes.

For read-only questions, explanations, exploration, research, reports, summaries, status checks, or standalone document creation, do not create or update CC Flow records unless explicitly requested.

Routine Git integration, tagging/release, and deployment of an existing reviewed artifact through an established runbook stay outside CC Flow unless semantic code/configuration changes are required; normal permission and production-safety requirements still apply.

For non-simple tasks, use the corresponding `.ai/tasks/<task>/` directory and complete its plan, result, and review records. Keep changes scoped, preserve compatibility unless the task explicitly changes it, run the repository's real checks, and update affected documentation.
